6.1.q: Which level of software design deals with data structures and algorithms?
6.1.vi: Detailed design: cấu trúc dữ liệu và thuật toán. Architectural: cấu trúc tổng thể. High-level: sub-system và module.
6.1.en: Detailed design covers data structures and algorithms; architectural is the overall structure; high-level is sub-systems and modules.

6.1.q: What is the difference between architectural design and software architecture?
o: Architectural design is the process; software architecture is its output document
Architectural design is the document; software architecture is the process
They are two names for the detailed design of algorithms
Architectural design happens after implementation; architecture before
6.1.vi: Architectural design là quá trình; software architecture là tài liệu, kết quả của quá trình đó.
6.1.en: Architectural design is the process; software architecture is the description of its result.

6.1.q: Architectural design is described as the stage that links:
6.1.vi: Architectural design là giai đoạn sớm, nối requirements engineering với design.
6.1.en: It is an early design stage linking requirements engineering and design processes.

6.1.q: A block diagram of the architecture is mainly useful for:
o: Communicating with stakeholders and planning the project
Proving that the algorithms are correct
6.1.vi: Block diagram (hộp và đường) giúp trao đổi với stakeholder và lập kế hoạch dự án.
6.1.en: Boxes and lines are useful for stakeholder communication and project planning.

6.1.q: What are the four levels of the C4 model, from widest to narrowest?
6.1.vi: C4 phóng to như bản đồ: System Context → Containers → Components → Code.
6.1.en: C4 zooms like a map: System Context → Containers → Components → Code.

6.1.q: In the C4 model, a web app, a mobile app, an API and a database are examples of:
6.1.vi: Container là đơn vị chạy hoặc triển khai được: web app, mobile app, API, database.
6.1.en: Containers are deployable or runnable units: web app, mobile app, API, database.

6.2.q: Which is an example of a sub-system rather than a module?
o: Google Maps embedded in an app
A UI component on your website
6.2.vi: Sub-system là một hệ thống riêng, chạy độc lập, như Google Maps nhúng vào app. Module như một UI component.
6.2.en: A sub-system is a system in its own right, like Google Maps in an app; a UI component is a module.

6.2.q: Which is NOT one of the three advantages of an explicit software architecture listed in the lecture?
6.2.vi: Ba lợi ích: stakeholder communication, system analysis, large-scale reuse.
6.2.en: The three: stakeholder communication, system analysis, large-scale reuse.

6.2.q: To improve security, the architecture should:
o: Use a layered architecture with critical assets in the inner layers
Use large-grain components and minimize communication
Add redundant components for fault tolerance
6.2.vi: Security: layered, tài sản quan trọng ở lớp trong. Large-grain là cho performance, redundant cho availability, fine-grain cho maintainability.
6.2.en: Security: layered with critical assets inside. Large-grain is for performance, redundancy for availability, fine-grain for maintainability.

6.2.q: Using large-grain components improves performance but reduces:
6.2.vi: Architectural conflict: component lớn giúp performance nhưng giảm maintainability.
6.2.en: Architectural conflict: large-grain components help performance but reduce maintainability.

o: Non-functional requirements plus some high-priority functional needs
Requirements that do not affect technology choices
6.2.vi: Requirement ảnh hưởng lớn tới kiến trúc: chủ yếu là NFR và vài FR ưu tiên cao.
6.2.en: They address non-functional concerns and some high-priority functional needs.

6.3.q: Which is NOT listed as an element of a design decision?
6.3.vi: Một quyết định gồm: issues, decision, assumptions, rationale, alternatives, implications.
6.3.en: Elements: issues, decision, assumptions, rationale, alternatives, implications.

6.3.q: "How will the system be decomposed into modules?" is:
o: One of the questions for architectural design
A step of detailed design only
Part of the use case specification
6.3.vi: Đây là một trong 7 câu hỏi khi thiết kế kiến trúc.
6.3.en: It is one of the seven questions for architectural design.

6.3.q: In the example decision "three-tier architecture with an OO language", what was the issue?
o: The system has to be maintainable
The system must handle 1,000 transactions per second
The team had no OO experience
The database had to be MySQL
6.3.vi: Issue: hệ thống phải dễ bảo trì. Rationale: đổi một tầng không ảnh hưởng tầng khác.
6.3.en: Issue: the system has to be maintainable. Rationale: one tier can change without affecting the others.

6.3.q: Which status value does an ADR template list?
6.3.vi: Status của ADR: proposed, accepted, superseded by ADR-007.
6.3.en: ADR status: proposed, accepted, superseded by ADR-007.

6.3.vi: ADR = Architecture Decision Record, lưu trong docs/adr/.
6.3.en: ADR = Architecture Decision Record, kept in docs/adr/.

6.4.q: How does an architectural style differ from a design pattern?
o: A style is high-level and addresses the whole system; a pattern is a micro-architecture
A style is low-level code; a pattern is the overall system structure
A style applies only to databases; a pattern only to UIs
6.4.vi: Style ở high-level design, cả hệ thống. Design pattern là micro-architecture, không nói về cấu trúc cả hệ thống.
6.4.en: A style is at high-level design; a pattern is a micro-architecture that does not address the complete system.

6.4.q: An architectural style is described in the form of:
6.4.vi: Một style được mô tả bằng Problem, Context, Solution.
6.4.en: A style is described as Problem, Context, Solution.

6.4.q: Which is a disadvantage of the repository style?
o: Sub-systems must agree on one repository data model
Large amounts of data cannot be shared
6.4.vi: Repository: phải thống nhất một data model (luôn là thoả hiệp), đổi data model khó, khó phân tán.
6.4.en: Repository: one agreed data model (a compromise), costly data evolution, hard to distribute.

6.4.q: Which is a disadvantage of the client-server style?
o: There is no shared data model
All data sits in one central repository
6.4.vi: Client-server: không có data model chung, trao đổi dữ liệu có thể kém hiệu quả, không có registry trung tâm.
6.4.en: Client-server: no shared data model, possibly inefficient interchange, no central register.

o: Every node can act as both client and server
One central server controls all communication
Clients never talk to each other
Data is always kept consistent automatically
6.4.vi: P2P: mỗi node vừa client vừa server, không có server trung tâm.
6.4.en: P2P: every node is both client and server, with no central server.

6.5.q: In a layered style, when a layer's interface changes:
o: Only the adjacent layer is affected
Only the database layer is affected
6.5.vi: Layered hỗ trợ phát triển tăng dần: đổi interface của một lớp chỉ ảnh hưởng lớp kề bên.
6.5.en: Only the adjacent layer is affected, which supports incremental development.

6.5.q: Which is a disadvantage of the layered style?
o: Performance problems from going through many layers
Changes to the UI affect every layer
6.5.vi: Layered: giao tiếp cứng nhắc giữa các lớp, chậm vì đi qua nhiều lớp.
6.5.en: Layered: inflexible communication, performance cost of many layers.

6.5.q: In MVC, which component accepts commands and input?
6.5.vi: Controller nhận lệnh và input, chuyển lệnh đi. Model: dữ liệu và logic. View: trình bày.
6.5.en: Controller accepts and passes on commands; Model holds data and logic; View presents.

6.5.q: Which is a disadvantage of pipes and filters?
o: It is difficult to support event-based interaction
New transformations are hard to add
6.5.vi: Pipes & filters: cần định dạng dữ liệu chung và khó hỗ trợ tương tác theo sự kiện.
6.5.en: Pipes and filters need a common data format and struggle with event-based interaction.

6.5.q: The interrupt-driven style is used where:
o: A fast response to an event is essential, as in real-time systems
Large amounts of data must be shared
Services are exposed over the web
6.5.vi: Interrupt-driven dùng cho hệ thống thời gian thực; phản hồi nhanh nhưng khó lập trình và khó validate.
6.5.en: It is for real-time systems; fast response but complex to program and hard to validate.

6.6.q: Which set lists the four traits of service-oriented architecture on the slide?
6.6.vi: SOA: modularity, interoperability, reusability, loose coupling. Bộ autonomy… là của microservices.
6.6.en: SOA: modularity, interoperability, reusability, loose coupling. Autonomy… belongs to microservices.

6.6.q: In a microservice architecture, each service can be:
o: Deployed only together with all other services
Changed only by editing a shared database schema
Run only on a single server
6.6.vi: Microservices: mỗi service phát triển, triển khai và mở rộng độc lập.
6.6.en: Each microservice is developed, deployed and scaled independently.

6.6.q: According to the lecture, what should a small team building a new product start with?
6.6.vi: Nhóm nhỏ, sản phẩm mới: bắt đầu bằng modular monolith, chỉ tách service khi có nhu cầu rõ ràng.
6.6.en: Start with a modular monolith; split into services only when there is a clear need.

6.6.q: Which is a disadvantage of event-driven architecture?
o: End-to-end flows are harder to trace and debug
6.6.vi: Event-driven: khó lần theo và debug, eventual consistency, đổi schema event phải quản lý version.
6.6.en: Event-driven: hard to trace and debug, eventual consistency, careful schema versioning.
